name: uart_rx_8e1
description: UART receive, 8E1 at 20 clocks per bit on in0 (uio5), with timer0 resync. The coded shifter samples start, 8 data bits, the even parity bit and the stop bit; its status bit 6 (word bad) is set when parity or the stop bit is wrong. The lane pushes every byte followed by a tag byte (0 good, 0x40 bad), so a bad byte is kept and marked instead of failing the transfer.
